items.label: Фрукты рядом с цветочным киоском
items.requirements: Connected counter, three large produce trays and open canopy. Keep apples/pears/citrus readable after simplification.

items.label: Велосипеды у школьного квартала
items.requirements: Two bicycles / four wheels, chunky disc centres and one rack. Reference uses simplified toy bikes without a visible drivetrain; accepted as static toy design. Do not add thin spokes or chains. All four wheels must share ground plane.

items.label: Небольшая площадка в парке
items.requirements: Connected slide and one stationary swing. Source shows a large set; fit actual GLB uniformly to declared bounds and verify every foot. No animated seat requested.

items.label: Вазон у северного края парка
items.requirements: Five broad blooms and compact connected leaves. Do not spend geometry on tiny stems; preserve pot silhouette.

items.label: Афиша между клубом и магазином
items.requirements: Music note and sun/star are flat pictorial graphics. Cap/base are modestly wider than the cylinder: target width includes them.

items.label: Питьевой фонтанчик у площадки
items.requirements: Empty basin with integrated spout and button. Decorative dry asset, no new water interaction.

items.label: Урна у магазина — замена корпуса
items.requirements: Open shell only: image suggests depth but does not prove geometric openness. Require real unobstructed top opening >=.56 after fitting; preserve coded .84 lid/cat.

items.label: Почтовый ящик у бабушки — замена корпуса
items.requirements: Shell/post only, no flag or letter. Native assembly must preserve coded flag pivot (.24,.95,.1) and letter; geometry cannot fill their motion clearance.

specialQA.city-street-bin: Open shell only. Exterior .76 diameter at top/.64 at bottom, height .9. Actual free top opening diameter >=.56, interior must not have false cap. Check geometry/rays through opening in the cat emergence volume. Existing coded lid diameter .84, hinge (0,.92,-.4), rotateX0..-1.9. Reconstruct matching moving parts from src/life.ts in own QA fixture, without editing src. Check lid continuous sweep and cat pop-up; identify intentional closed rim contact separately. No generated lid/cat.
specialQA.city-postbox: Static shell/post only, no generated flag/letter. Original flag pivot(.24,.95,.1), rotateZ0..-pi/2, preserve original code. Check lateral shell clearance through sweep in own QA fixture; letter starts emerging near(.35,1.05,0). Document intentional letter emergence instead of claiming zero overlaps everywhere. If source proportions obstruct, preserve candidate and report exact blocker before destructive cuts.
